author: Yffe
content:
RESULT — #265 resolved as DOC amendment (record fidelity, not soundness). Commit d158a73a.

Authority adjudication (critic pin lean/Thermite/PinWhileDecShape.lean, commit 92659eb7): the shipped loopDenote_exits_of_dec takes the PRE-state bound 0<=mu st, which is STRICTLY WEAKER than the §4.2.2-pinned POST-state 0<=mu st' — the shipped theorem is strictly MORE GENERAL and sound. shipped_hdec_is_not_the_pinned_shape proves the two shapes non-equivalent; loopDenote_exits_of_dec_design_shape kernel-derives the POST-state statement as a corollary. So the fix is to re-pin the DOC, NOT to touch any Lean file.

File: .design/verified/proof-backends.md (single file, +29/-3 LOC net across 3 hunks). No Lean file touched (the pin stays as the kernel record; the shipped theorem is correct as-is).

BEFORE (§4.2.2 sketch, line 1780 / REQ-11.3 row line 440):
  h_dec : ... -> mu st' < mu st AND 0 <= mu st'     (POST-state)
  'STATEMENT SHAPE is the §4.2.2 sketch verbatim'
AFTER (§4.2.2 sketch line 1794):
  h_dec : ... -> mu st' < mu st AND 0 <= mu st       (PRE-state)
  now verbatim-identical to the SHIPPED Exec/WhileBody.lean:244:
  '... blockThread lbody st = some st' -> mu st' < mu st AND 0 <= mu st'

Three hunks:
1. §4.2.2 statement block: 0<=mu st' -> 0<=mu st + declared-adaptation note (PRE-state is the strictly weaker hypothesis -> more general theorem; POST-state shape is the pin's kernel-derived corollary loopDenote_exits_of_dec_design_shape; the mu st=0 / cond-true corner closed by deriving next-condition-false — the builder's recorded proof structure).
2. REQ-11.3 SHIPPED row: dropped 'verbatim'; states the one declared semantic adaptation with the PinWhileDecShape.lean cite; notes the adaptation strengthens (never weakens) the theorem.
3. (v-a) kernel-bar: added one sentence recording the #265 critic observation — default 'lake build' (defaultTargets [Thermite]) elaborates only modules reachable from Thermite.lean (which imports Exec/WhileBody.lean but NOT the Pin* modules), so a pin's kernel check is asserted by explicit per-module 'lake env lean Thermite/PinWhileDecShape.lean', not the default build.

Gauntlet (integer counts):
- cd lean && lake build: green, 369 jobs, EXIT 0 (no Lean touched — sanity; the lone sorry warning is the vendored lean-smt Bitblast.lean dep, not Thermite).
- lake env lean Thermite/PinWhileDecShape.lean: EXIT 0 (confirms the kernel-bar claim is true).
- python3 tooling/doc-drift.py: EXIT 0, proof-backends.md reported CURRENT.
- Internal-consistency re-read: §4.2.2 line 1794 '0 <= mu st' now matches WhileBody.lean:244 '0 <= mu st' character-for-character.

No new pub API (R-DEFER-1 n/a). Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
